typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import 'Outfit' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts. Use Outfit exclusively for structural headings (H1-H4). Use JetBrains Mono for all body text, metrics, tables, navigation, and code snippets. This creates a highly technical, precise developer-tool aesthetic.

colors.archetype: Electric & Neon (Future, Speed, Disruption) layered over deep structural blacks. Adjusted for CV technical precision.
colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Use dark mode as default. Map these custom hex codes into tailwind.config.js under the 'dark' block of the colors theme. Never use pure #000000, always use #050505. Avoid gradients. Solid blocks of color create a technical 'terminal' feel. Use annotation colors strictly for canvas bounding boxes, polygon traces, and AI auto-labeling indicators.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use `border-collapse` layout where applicable for tables and stat blocks. Items separated by 1px solid borders (`border-border`).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on crisp 1px strokes instead of soft box-shadows. This is a developer tool, not a consumer social app.
visual_enhancers.radii: Sharp precision. Use `rounded-sm` (4px) or `rounded-none` for all containers, buttons, and inputs.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Restricted! Only use high-saturation glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#121212]/80 border-b border-white/10`) for the sticky top navigation or floating action bars. Never use over the image annotation area.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: High Density Protocol. Use `gap-4` or `gap-6` for dashboard widget grids. Use `p-4` or `p-6` inside cards.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Start mobile-first (`grid-cols-1`). On desktop, use `md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4`. Use F-Pattern layout: Key project metrics top-left, list of datasets/models spanning downward.
grids_and_layouts.annotation_workspace: Three-pane layout: Left sidebar (tools), Center (canvas/image), Right sidebar (classes/labels list).
grids_and_layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Grid items MUST be direct children. Override default stretch with `items-start` if needed. Use flexbox with `justify-between` for dense list items.

components.buttons: Sharp buttons (`rounded-sm`). Primary buttons use solid Cyan (`bg-primary text-black hover:bg-cyan-400`). Secondary buttons use transparent background with border (`border border-border hover:bg-surface_hover`).
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to `rounded-sm`, `bg-transparent`, and a `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary` state. Never remove focus outlines.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic preferred, or flat rectangular panels. `border border-border bg-surface` with zero shadow.
components.tables: Dense. JetBrains Mono font. 1px bottom border on rows. No alternating background colors (keep it clean).
components.dropdowns: CRITICAL: NO transparent backgrounds. Must have solid `bg-surface` with `border border-border`.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on lists and buttons must have a discrete color shift. Example: `hover:bg-[#1C1C1C] transition-colors duration-150`.
motion.canvas: Zero transition on canvas elements (bounding boxes) for instant response time.
motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use `transition-all`. Specify `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`, or `transition-transform` explicitly. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. If text is over an image, add a text-shadow or a dark scrim.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must display a high-contrast focus ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: `data-testid='add-polygon-button'`.

icons.instructions_to_main_agent: Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`. Use standard Phosphor icons with `weight='regular'`.

3d_libraries.instructions_to_main_agent: Not recommended for this specific 2D computer vision annotation tool. Stick to Recharts for the model training simulation & deployment dashboard (loss curves, mAP metrics).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align text and data unless symmetry explicitly helps.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep surface textures flat (no heavy drop shadows).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters ONLY on floating headers, NOT on content-heavy sections.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles, specifically sharp or pill-shaped with distinct hover states.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
CRITICAL: Include `data-testid` on all buttons, forms, and interactive inputs.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Install components as `.js` or `.jsx` instead of `.tsx` since this is a JS project.
